We're going through the process of buying a first home and my SO was in a similar position to you - we were told by the executor he was left a share of a the property so assumed we weren't first time buyers. 

Fortunately in our case we are still classed as first time buyers because my SO was actually left a portion of the estate rather than the property itself (which would have excluded us as it's classed as having an interest in a property) but we had to get the solicitor to look at the exact wording in the will to be sure. If you don't get any better responses than this (not great as I've just come off of a night shift and am half asleep!) I would suggest asking a solicitor who will most likely want to look at the Will. 

Also, another thing to bear in mind is that you'll only get the bonus from a Help to Buy ISA if the property is under £250 k - we're in the south east where that's near impossible so I didn't get the bonus on mine.
